svg.text: Step 07.6 - Cognitive Services User for APIM
Portal path: Azure Portal > Foundry account > Access control (IAM) > + Add > Add role
assignment > Role Cognitive Services User > Members: Managed identity > + Select members > API
Management > intended APIM > Review + assign. Repeat for every same-tenant Foundry backend at
that account scope. Do not grant the app Owner, and do not use an account key.
Screenshot pending - capture in lab tenant, redact identifiers
